newsitem.title: FRANCE: France gets more rain but dry weather in store.
newsitem.headline: France gets more rain but dry weather in store.

text.p: Light rain fell on northern and eastern France on Monday and more rain was expected on Tuesday.
But forecasters said dry weather was set to return by midweek.
"The weather is set to turn dry again on Wednesday and this could last until Saturday," a Meteo France forecaster said.
Meteo France said an estimated 10 mm fell across the country over the weekend, bringing parched crops some relief after a three-month dry spell.
In the Beauce grain belt, weekend rain was heavier than expected, reaching 20 mm.
"This did the crops some good although this is not sufficient to replenish water tables," the forecaster said.
A further 3-5 mm was forecast for eastern and northern France on Monday.
On Monday afternoon it was raining lightly over the north, the east, the southwest and parts of the southeast.
France's largest farm union FNSEA has warned that the dry spell has already done irreversible damage to the winter grain crop.
